thread:
Marta (sales): Hey team — CedarHealth signed the MSA, they're asking for a compact deliverable list for DD so procurement can sign off. They specifically want SOC 2 artifacts, a pen-test letter, and confirmation on isolated tenancy pricing impact. Can we pull a short checklist?

Jon S (solutions): I can draft a POC-specific checklist. Quick Q: their POC needs staging in us-west with static egress IPs and optional KMS separation. Do we have pre-approved network diagram and a template IP allowlist we can share?

Priya K (security): Yes we have a network diagram PDF and the KMS separation options. For pen-test letter — we need to confirm scope (external only, or external+internal). Also clarify whether customer requires vendor-supplied red-team or they'll accept our standard attestation.

Marta (sales): CedarHealth says external scan + network diagram is fine for now, but legal might push for an internal scan later. They also asked about Dedicated (single-tenant) monthly delta and any extra for KMS/HSM. Pricing ask is urgent — procurement deadline Fri EOD.

Sam L (legal): I have the standard pen-test attestation template. We can sign and date once security confirms wording. If they want a letter on vendor letterhead, I'll route to ops for signature. Link to template: https://redwood-internal.share/pen-test-templates/standard-attest.pdf

Priya K (security): OK — here are the artifacts we'll provide for DD: SOC 2 Type II executive summary PDF, control matrix excerpt (redacted), pen-test attestation template (signed), network diagram for hosted+dedicated, staging IP allowlist, and procedure for presigned S3 upload of logs. I can assemble a zipped bundle.

Jon S (solutions): For the POC creds — we can spin a staging tenant with static IPs. I'll create a short runbook for connectivity:
```
- Bastion IP: 34.215.101.22 (for initial tests)
- Staging UI creds: poc_user / <rotating_secret>
- S3 presigned path: s3://redwood-poc-uploads/cedarhealth/ (we'll issue 24h presigned links)
```

Marta (sales): Awesome. Can we also include a one-line note about SLA/uptime for POC (non-prod) so procurement knows this isn't PROD SLA?

Priya K (security): I'll add an explicit note: "POC staging environment is not covered under production SLAs; uptime best-effort, monitoring enabled."

Sam L (legal): Pricing delta: Marta please send me the customer's exact Dedicated sizing (GPU count / vCPU). Pricing team approved a one-time setup + monthly commit. I'll confirm numbers and add the legal caveat for audit support.

Marta (sales): their ask: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs, 2TB memory pool, reserved for 3 months. Quick estimate given privately: +$18k/mo + $6k one-time setup. Can pricing team confirm? @audit-bot do we have a sample SOC2 bundle summary link?

audit-bot: SOC2 summary: https://redwood-secure/docs/soc2/executive-summary.txt (access requires auth)

Priya K (security): Timeline: I can produce the zipped bundle (redacted SOC2 excerpt, control matrix excerpt, network diagram, pen-test attestation) by Thu COB. For the signed pen-test letter we'll need legal to sign, target Fri. Internal scan evidence will be follow-up if requested.

Jon S (solutions): I'll prepare the staging tenant and runbook by Thu morning. Will include instructions for whitelist and sample curl test to verify connectivity.

Marta (sales): Great — I'll message CedarHealth and set expectation: bundle by Thu, pen-test letter by Fri, pricing quote for Dedicated by EOD Thu. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Priya K (security): One more item — if CedarHealth requires KMS separation (customer-managed key), we need a short KMS onboarding checklist and estimated 48–72h for key provisioning. I'll include that in the bundle.

Sam L (legal): Noted. Marta — please get a signed PoC scope (one page) from CedarHealth and drop it here so I can attach the pen-test attestation to the right agreement.

Marta (sales): Will do. Pinging them now.

(3 edits)
